title: San manyan abokan cinikin ku: fallasa, amana da ƙimar lafiya
course_title: Babban Gudanarwar Abokin Ciniki: Tsayawa da Haɓaka Abokan Ciniki Masu Mahimmanci

say: San manyan abokan cinikin ku: fallasa, amana da ƙimar lafiya.
Wannan shine bidiyon don module ɗaya na Babban Gudanarwar Abokin Ciniki.
Babban asusun ƙima abokin ciniki ne wanda ke biyan ku akai-akai, sau da yawa akan mai riƙewa kowane wata, kuma wanda asararsa zai cutar da kuɗin shiga.
Mai riƙewa ƙayyadaddun kuɗi ne don adadin da aka yarda na aiki mai gudana.

card.title: Nawa abokin ciniki ɗaya ke ɗauka?
card.note: Misalin ƙididdiga don aiki, ba farashin kasuwa ba.

say: Ta jera kuɗin kowane abokin ciniki na wata-wata. Abokin ciniki A yana biyan Naira 600,000, Client B 250,000, Client C 200,000, Client D da E 150,000 da 100,000.

card.title: Nawa abokin ciniki ɗaya ke ɗauka?

say: Tare wato naira miliyan 1,300,000 a wata.
Rabon abokin ciniki A shine 600,000 da aka raba da 1,300,000, wanda shine kusan kashi 46% na kudin shiga.
Idan babu Client A, samun kudin shiga ya ragu zuwa naira 700,000, wanda ya kai 200,000 kasa da kudinta a kowane wata.

card.title: Nawa abokin ciniki ɗaya ke ɗauka?
card.note: Misalin ƙididdiga don aiki, ba farashin kasuwa ba.

say: Wannan haɗarin ana kiran haɗarin maida hankali: ya danganta da abokin ciniki ɗaya ko biyu don babban kaso na kudin shiga. Maganin ba don guje wa manyan abokan ciniki ba. Shi ne a sarrafa su da ƙarin kulawa.
Abokan ciniki na dabaru suna samun mai shi ko babban mutum, rajistan shiga kowane wata, da bita na kwata.

cards.d: Babban rabon samun kudin shiga, dakin girma. Babban jagora, shiga kowane wata, bita na kwata.
Adadin kuɗin wata-wata, dacewa mai kyau. Jagorar asusun mai suna, sabuntawa na sati biyu, bita sau biyu a shekara.
Ƙananan aiki ko lokaci-lokaci, iyaka mai sauƙi. Ingantaccen sabis, samfuri, sabuntawa a kowane bayarwa.

say: Maɓallin abokan ciniki suna biyan kuɗi akai-akai kowane wata. Suna samun jagorar asusu mai suna, sabuntawa kowane mako biyu, da bita sau biyu a shekara.

Tiers game da matakin sabis ne, ba girmamawa ba. Kowane abokin ciniki har yanzu ya cancanci ladabi da bayarwa akan lokaci. Yi bitar matakan kowane kwata.

say: Abokan ciniki ba safai suke barin ba saboda kuskure ɗaya. Suna barin lokacin da suka daina amincewa da ku. Equation Amintaccen ya karya amana zuwa sassa hudu.
Amincewa: kun san filin ku kuma ku yarda lokacin da ba ku sani ba.

say: Daidaiton kai yana zaune a ƙarƙashin sauran ukun. Lokacin da kuka tura tallace-tallace naku, yana tashi kuma amana ya faɗi.

Alal misali, Ngozi, mai kula da littattafai, ta sami nasarar 4 amintacce bayan rahotanni biyu da suka makara. Ta aika da rahotanni a ranar 5 ga kowane wata kuma ta daina yin wasa, kuma sakamakon amincewarta ya tashi daga 3.4 zuwa 7.0.

say: Abubuwan da aka ɓace yawanci suna nuna alamun gargaɗi makonni kafin abokin ciniki ya faɗi haka. Makin lafiya yana tattara waɗannan alamun zuwa lamba ɗaya.
Sau ɗaya a wata, saka sigina biyar daga 1, mara kyau, zuwa 5, mai kyau.

say: Don tunawa. Ku san rabon kowane abokin ciniki na kuɗin shiga ku. Daidaita lokacin ku da matakin. Ci gaba da ƙananan alkawura kuma ku sayar da ƙasa. Kuma ci lafiyar asusun a kowane wata, yin aiki da sauri akan amber ko ja.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Yi aiki da rabon kowane abokin ciniki na kuɗin shiga
Rarraba abokan ciniki cikin dabaru, maɓalli da ma'auni
Amincewa yana faɗuwa lokacin da kai ya tashi
Maki lafiyar asusun a kowane wata kuma kuyi aiki akan amber

say: Yanzu taswirar bayyanar kuɗin shiga ku, yi amintacce bincikar kai don muhimmin abokin ciniki ɗaya, kuma saka manyan asusun ku guda uku.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.

panel.heading: Ayyukan aikin ku
items: Taswirar bayyanar kuɗin shiga ku
Yi amanar ku duba kanku
Maki manyan asusun ku guda uku
